newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl confirms Bonn 97 GDP growth outlook 2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kohl confirms Bonn 97 GDP growth outlook 2.5 pct.

text.p: Chancellor Helmut Kohl confirmed on Friday the German government expects gross domestic product to expand 2.5 percent this year.
Expansion in world trade will create jobs in Germany. Every fifth job in germany depends on exports, he told parliament.
"We expect economic growth to accelerate in 1997 to 2.5 pct from 1.4 pct in 1996," he said.
Kohl confirms Bonn 97 GDP growth outlook 2.5 pct
Kohl affirmed that his government stands by its goal of halving unemployment in Germany by the end of the decade.

"We will halve unemployment by the end of the decade," Kohl told parliament. "It is an ambitious goal and no one can do all that alone. Everyone has to work together towards that goal -- unions, employers and government."
